comments.text:
👋 Hey Product Hunt!

I'm Swati, Co-founder of ReSO!

Having led marketing across B2B, B2C for 2 decades, organic has been my favorite revenue growth channel. Somewhere in the last two years I noticed my own buying behaviour change; every serious purchase started with a question to ChatGPT or Google AI. 

And when buyers ask AI "which one should I choose?" only 3-5 brands exist in the answer. In that moment every brand which is not in the answer loses a potential customer.

The problem: When we started auditing brands, we kept finding the same thing; companies ranking on page 1 of Google that were near-invisible in AI answers, losing recommendations to smaller competitors. And the tools out there mostly tell you that you're invisible. Very few tell you why. Almost none tell you what to do about it today.

So we built ReSO a custom agentic employee to own organic search growth channel, acquire customers & drive revenue:

1️⃣ Discover: Find real questions your buyers ask AI, across every intent & funnel stage (discovery, comparisons, alternatives, "best X for Y"…).

2️⃣ Measure: Runs the queries across ChatGPT, Perplexity & Google AI Overviews, and shows exactly where you're mentioned, cited, and recommended and where competitors beat you.

3️⃣ Diagnose: Pinpoints the AI trust gaps behind every loss: a 240+ check audit of your technical eligibility, content readiness, and authority signals.

4️⃣ Fix + Create: Turns those gaps into a prioritized weekly action plan & helps you execute it: technical fixes, page improvements, and new research-backed content engineered from real citation data.

5️⃣ Track: Re-verifies every fix and tracks your visibility vs competitors week over week, so progress is measured, not assumed.

What makes ReSO different: Most AI visibility tools stop at monitoring. We treat measurement as step one, not the product. The product is the movement from unmentioned, to cited, to recommended. ReSO is your company’s employee who takes ownership of results.

Who its for: Founders, SEO & content teams, and agencies who can see search shifting and want a system & not another report to win it.

🎁 For the PH community: Free AI visibility audit of your brand & 100% off one month access for launch-week signups worth USD 599

🙏 Our ask: Honest feedback over upvotes. Tell me when your buyers ask AI about your category, do you know if you show up? Drop your site in the comments and I'll share what we find. I'll be here all day.

Big shout-out to my small but relentless team who turned this from a spreadsheet obsession into a product and thank you @jonnotie, the PH team, and this community for the platform to share it.

comments.author: Soohyun Bae
comments.text:
Hey Product Hunt 👋 SB here, founder of Onepin. Thanks @rohanrecommends for hunting us.  
  
A great AI voice reads "Porsche Taycan" as TAY-can. Porsche says TIE-kahn. It guessed from the spelling, and nobody caught it, because nobody listens to line 1,200.  
  
We spent two years at Podonos measuring how AI voices sound, with 150,000 human listeners doing the rating. The models solved delivery. What kept failing was names, prices and dates, and the only check most teams run is a person with headphones.  
  
Today we're launching Onepin, the production step after text-to-speech. It runs on the voices you already use, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google and 30+ more, and checks every line before it ships.  
  
Here is what it does to every script:  
🔢 Spells out prices, dates and abbreviations before the voice reads them.  
📖 Checks names, brands and drug terms against a 4-million-word pronunciation dictionary.  
📊 Scores every line for naturalness, clarity, word accuracy and pronunciation, against a bar you set.  
🔧 Fixes the one wrong word in the same voice, without re-rendering the take.  
  
Two decisions we made on purpose. Onepin checks how a name was said, not just what the transcript spells. And there is no box where you type phonetic spellings: the dictionary and the fix do that work, so your script stays as written.  
  
Built for anyone shipping AI voiceover at volume: product videos, ads, explainers, dubbing, audiobooks, courses, and platforms that put a voice in front of millions of users. API, SDK and MCP from day one. SOC 2 Type II.  
  
You keep your voice. Onepin makes sure it says the right words.  
  
Free to start, no card: onepin.ai. You can run one line on the homepage without an account.  
  
Try it and tell me what's missing, here or at sb@onepin.ai. We'll be in the comments all day, answering questions and running your lines. 🚀  
  
🎁 LAUNCH SPECIAL: 20% off for Product Hunt users through October 31. The code is under the 20% off badge above.  
  
One question for you: what's the word your AI voice keeps getting wrong? Run it on onepin.ai (free, no card), switch the run to shareable, and paste the link below so everyone can hear the before and after. I'll reply to every one. No time to sign up? Drop the word and I'll run a few today.

comments.text:
@soohyun Many congratulations Soohyun on the Onepin launch! 😊

How I met the maker: I met the maker through a Product Hunt friend, who asked whether I’d be interested in checking out and hunting the product. The moment I saw Onepin’s landing page, I knew I wanted to hunt it, it was addressing a very real and often overlooked pain point.

What is Onepin: Onepin is a production layer for AI text-to-speech. It works with voices you already use, including ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, and 30+ others, and reviews every line before you ship it.

It spells out prices, dates, and abbreviations correctly, checks names, brands, and specialized terms, scores each line, and fixes mistakes in the same voice without leaving the page or re-rendering the entire take. That combination is what makes it unique.

Why I endorse it: AI voices can sound great, but one mispronounced name, price, or date can undermine an otherwise polished video, course, ad, or voice agent. Onepin turns that manual, error-prone review process into a scalable quality check.

The product is clearly already getting attention, one friend even told me I should hunt it after seeing it on social media, not realizing I already had. 😄

comments.author: Rohan Chaubey
comments.text:
Meet Microsoft-Decision-1 from Microsoft: a model built for fast, structured decisions, not text generation. You give it a situation and fixed options, and it returns a calibrated probability for each one in a single pass, so your software can act on the answer directly.

You now get:

*   Probabilities for yes/no, multiple-choice and rating options, with no text to parse
    
*   Rubric-based grading of AI responses and agent actions, through a structured API call
    
*   A small, fast model post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B for decision scoring, which Microsoft says it will rebase on other models, including Microsoft AI (MAI) and OpenAI models
    

What’s new?

1.  Built for decisions, not chat: LLMs generate text or reason through complex problems. Decision-1 handles routing, classification, prioritization, verification and workflow control, where the answer is a choice among known options.
    
2.  Speed that adds up: Microsoft’s example is that 100 ms added to each of 20 sequential decisions adds two seconds to a workflow. In its tests, Decision-1 is 4.5x faster than the runner-up (Quyet-1.0-Large) and about 35x faster than GPT-6 Sol at median latency.
    
3.  Accuracy and generalization: Microsoft reports the highest accuracy in a 36-benchmark comparison covering nearly 150,000 questions kept blind from training, and the best results on JevBench across 36 additional public and private benchmarks.
    
4.  Consistent decisions: Across eight types of input changes, it changes its decision on 1.3% of cases on average, and never when option descriptions are paraphrased or options are reversed or shuffled.
    
5.  Safety: It was tested on 5,250 requests across 11 benchmarks (harmful content, jailbreaks, prompt injection), and Microsoft says it refused harmful behavior while keeping high utility.
    

Where Microsoft is already using it:

*   Xbox Research labeled more than 10,000 pieces of feedback at quality competitive with GPT-6 Sol, over 14x faster and 200x cheaper
    
*   The Copilot team saw quality competitive with GPT-5.6 Luna at 100x the speed
    
*   Microsoft Discovery got scores 46x more consistent than the LLM-based version, at three times the speed
    

Listed use cases: agent controls, model routing, data labeling, AI judging, intent analysis, incident routing, data validation, search relevance, content filtering, code scanning, safety screening, computer use, robotics and scientific discovery.

Pricing and availability:

*   Available now in Microsoft Foundry
    
*   OpenRouter is coming soon
    
*   $0.042 per million input tokens, and output tokens are free
    

Try it: Microsoft Foundry · Launch post

comments.author: Brandon Ta
comments.text: Hi PH 👋 Honest intro: I vibe-coded Cue with Claude. I had free tokens and a habit of opening YouTube "for one second", so this happened. The idea is small: your headphones are the focus switch. - Put your AirPods in → Cue turns on your Focus mode (Do Not Disturb by default), blocks the sites you picked and starts a timer in the notch. - Take them out → break. The sites come back and the buddies take a nap. Other stuff that crept in: now playing, volume and brightness in the notch, your own notch colors, a session history, and two little buddies that react to pretty much everything. No notch? Cue draws a small floating pill instead. Limits, so nobody is surprised: - Apple Silicon, macOS 14+. - Wear detection needs AirPods Pro, AirPods 3/4 or AirPods Max. Other headphones work on connect/disconnect instead. - It is not notarized (that needs a paid developer account), so macOS asks you to click "Open Anyway" once. The site shows the steps. - Free, closed source, made by one person plus an AI. Bugs are possible, feedback is very welcome. Privacy: no accounts, no analytics. Cue only goes online for the feedback button and two one-time anonymous setup pings ("opened", "ready") so I know if anyone got it working. Nothing else leaves your Mac. Would love to hear what breaks 🙏
comments.kr: PH 여러분 안녕하세요 👋 솔직하게 소개해 드리자면, 저는 Claude를 활용해 '바이브 코딩(vibe-coding)'으로 Cue를 만들었습니다. 무료 토큰이 좀 있었고 "딱 1초만 봐야지" 하고 유튜브를 켜는 습관이 있어서 이 앱을 개발하게 되었습니다. 아이디어는 단순합니다. 헤드폰이 바로 집중 스위치가 되는 것입니다. - 에어팟을 귀에 꽂으면 → Cue가 집중 모드(기본값은 방해금지 모드)를 켜고, 설정해 둔 사이트들을 차단하며, 맥북 노치에서 타이머를 시작합니다. - 에어팟을 빼면 → 휴식 시간입니다. 사이트 차단이 해제되고 노치의 캐릭터 친구들이 낮잠을 잡니다. 그 외에 덧붙여진 기능들: 노치에서의 미디어 재생 정보 표시, 볼륨 및 밝기 조절, 노치 색상 커스텀, 세션 기록, 그리고 거의 모든 동작에 반응하는 두 마리의 귀여운 캐릭터 친구들입니다. 화면에 노치가 없다고요? Cue가 대신 화면에 작은 플로팅 알약 모양의 UI를 띄워줍니다. 당황하시지 않도록 미리 한계점을 말씀드립니다: - Apple Silicon, macOS 14 이상 지원. - 착용 감지는 AirPods Pro, AirPods 3/4, AirPods Max에서 작동합니다. 기타 헤드폰은 연결/연결 해제 시 작동합니다. - 아직 공증(notarization)을 받지 않아(유료 개발자 계정이 필요함) macOS에서 처음에 "어쨌든 열기(Open Anyway)"를 클릭해야 합니다. 사이트에 방법이 안내되어 있습니다. - 무료, 클로즈드 소스, 1인 개발자+AI 제작. 버그가 있을 수 있으며 피드백을 환영합니다. 개인정보 보호: 계정 가입 없음, 분석 툴 없음. Cue는 피드백 버튼과 앱이 정상 작동했는지 확인하기 위한 2개의 1회성 익명 핑("opened", "ready")을 제외하고는 인터넷에 연결되지 않습니다. 그 외 어떤 데이터도 Mac을 떠나지 않습니다. 어떤 문제든 편하게 알려주시면 감사하겠습니다 🙏
